_comment: Curated list of MLX models known to work with VoiceClip today.
Drives the 'Quick pick' dropdown in Settings for each *.local_model
field. Users can still paste any HuggingFace model id — this list
label      — short human name shown in the dropdown
size_gb    — approximate on-disk size after download (for the UI)
is auto-detected at load time from config.json)
good_for   — features this model is a sensible default for;
only shown in the dropdown for matching fields
note       — one-line guidance shown under the label
Keep the list small and opinionated — 6-10 entries max. Every entry
should be something we've verified loads cleanly and produces good
output at least once. Update via git, not at runtime.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct (default)
models.note: Balanced default — fast, clean output, no reasoning scratchpad.

models.label: Qwen 2.5 3B Instruct (fast)
models.note: Smaller and faster — best when you want day summaries in a hurry.

models.label: Gemma 3 4B QAT
models.note: Google's quant-aware-trained Gemma 3. Solid writing style.

models.label: Gemma 4 E2B
models.note: Smaller Gemma 4, loads via mlx-vlm. Use the non-OptiQ variant.

models.label: Gemma 4 E4B (quality research)
models.note: Biggest supported Gemma 4. Best fluency for research briefs.

models.label: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.note: Meta's compact instruct model. Similar speed to Qwen 2.5 3B.
